brief.topic: Should this feature use AI at all?
brief.audience: PMs and product leaders prioritising AI features

coreInsight: Use AI only when a fixed rule can't do the job, occasional errors are acceptable or catchable, and you have data to test it; otherwise ship the rule first.

caption.opening: Some of the best AI product decisions are “no AI here”.
body:
Use AI only if:
→ a fixed rule can’t do the job well
→ occasional errors are acceptable
→ a wrong answer can be caught or undone
→ you have real data to test it on
Fail two of the four? Ship the rule-based version first and revisit with data.
